criteria.reasoning: Only background reading and STK tutorials claimed, no results, plots or interpretation shown. Technical error on orbit undermines progress. Minimal evidence, low Adequate.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Well-written with headings and consistent formatting. Gantt unnumbered/uncaptioned, footnoted URLs not proper citations, so below professional Accomplished standard.

evidence.quote: Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue.

technical_issues.issue: States 'geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km' - technically incorrect; 600 km is LEO, GEO is ~35,786 km, confuses station-keeping over reef.
Timeline inconsistency: text says Weeks 7 and 8 reserved for review and final report due 20/11/20, but Gantt shows Editing & Finalisation in Wk9-10.

overall: Good reef-monitoring concept with users and rationale. Plan feasible but lacks contingencies/sources. Little technical results and major orbit error limit progress.

feedback.summary: You presented a strong reef-monitoring concept with clear users and need. Your Gantt shows a feasible plan and writing is clear. To progress, correct the orbit definition, strengthen contingencies and sources, and add early technical results with proper figures and referencing.
next_steps: Correct your 600 km geostationary statement in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress to LEO vs ~35,786 km GEO and explain reef coverage strategy.
Add contingencies, mission-linked justification, and listed future information sources to your Gantt plan in Image 1.
Generate preliminary STK results with plots and interpretation for coverage/revisit to move beyond tutorials.

criteria.C1: You did well in Mission Concept & Rationale linking near-real-time relay, sea surface temperatures and bathymetry to marine scientists. To reach the top of Accomplished, add specific mission requirements and payload details with fuller literature links.
criteria.C2: You showed feasibility in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress with task breakdown and Image 1 Gantt. For Accomplished, add contingency provision, explain why the plan fits your mission narrative, and list future information sources.
criteria.C3: You noted background reading and STK tutorials 1-4 in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress. For Accomplished, include preliminary results with brief interpretation and fix the 600 km geostationary error to show you are on track.
criteria.C4: You wrote clearly with headings and consistent formatting. For Accomplished, number and caption your Gantt, ensure consistent figure/table style, and use proper in-text citations matching the reference list.
